voice: machine-ish structured log exported from the assistant platform
format: one line per record as 'key=value' pairs or YAML-like blocks (type: memory|rule|update|contact|calendar|pending); timestamps in the form 05/03/2024 18:42 (day/month/year)
verbosity: terse; no prose sentences except inside quoted values
notes: Put the pending item last, with options as a list under 'options:'.
